usedFor: Process Street runs checklists and workflows, and HubSpot receives a deal from “Create Deal” when a run completes.

bestTemplate.name: “Workflow Run Completed” in Process Street, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A finished run means the process is done, so the deal opens with that work behind it.

watchOut: “Data Set Record Updated” in Process Street is polling and fires on updates, so it can create a deal twice.
